# ownCloud (File Search) MCP connector

Search inside the files of an ownCloud server from your AI client over WebDAV: full-text index of PDF, Excel, Word and Outlook files, synced in the background. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 10 MCP tools for ownCloud (File Search).

[![Open ownCloud (File Search) in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Downcloud-file-search&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=owncloud-file-search)

**Category:** [File Storage](../storage.md) · **Tools:** 10 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/owncloud-file-search)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the ownCloud (File Search) connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The ownCloud (File Search) connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your ownCloud (File Search) account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/owncloud-file-search).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-owncloud-file-search-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-owncloud-file-search-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-owncloud-file-search-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-owncloud-file-search-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-owncloud-file-search-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-owncloud-file-search-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Show me invoice INV-2026-0345 for customer Bergheim Konsum, I need amount and invoice date*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["ownCloud (File Search) API"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, user name and password" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the ownCloud (File Search) credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (user name and password), calls ownCloud (File Search), logs the call and returns the result.
- **ownCloud (File Search)** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **ownCloud (File Search)**, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
